capabilities: Show dated checkbox tasks on a monthly calendar
Draw multi-day bars for tasks with start and due dates
Collect undated unfinished tasks in a pending panel grouped by note
Create tasks and toggle completion from the calendar
Assign card colors and dot markers to tasks
disambiguation: Not a task database or a replacement for a task manager plugin; it only reads Markdown checkbox lines from your notes and shows them on a calendar.
extras: Version 0.1 is verified on desktop only and marked desktop-only. Colors, markers and settings are stored in the plugin's data.json rather than in notes, so the plugin folder must be synced to keep them on another device. No network requests, account or analytics.
motivation: The author wanted a way to see at a glance what a month actually holds, because tasks written in notes end up scattered from one note to another.
problem: Tasks written across many notes are hard to survey, so there is no single place to see what is due this month or which tasks still have no date.

relations.evidence: Existing Kanban files are treated as read-only task sources
Use it on its own. Kanban and Tasks are not required.

summary: Monthly calendar view that places Markdown checkbox tasks from a chosen folder on their due dates, with multi-day bars and a pending-tasks panel.
